experiment_title: Illumina NovaSeq 6000 sequencing: GSM9844426: NAC103-Halo, DAP, rep1 Arabidopsis thaliana OTHER
library_construction_protocol: About 5 g of materials were collected from the liquid 1/2 MS medium and fixed with 1% formaldehyde. After nuclei extraction, the chromatin was sonicated using a Bioruptor (on, 30s off, 30s 15 cycles). For ChIP-seq, the DNA library was prepared using NEBNext® Ultra™ II DNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina according to the manufacturer's instructions. For DAP-seq, the DNA library was prepared using a VAHTS Universal DNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina V3 (ND607, Vazyme, China).
